readiness.name: all-graph-node-census
readiness.query: MATCH (n) RETURN n.graphId AS graph, count(n) AS nodes ORDER BY graph

cases.name: network-message-call-scan
cases.query: MATCH (c:CallSite) WHERE toLower(coalesce(c.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'message' OR toLower(coalesce(c.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'request' RETURN c.graphId AS graph, count(c) AS calls ORDER BY graph

cases.name: literal-call-provenance
cases.query: MATCH (s:StringConstant)-[:DATAFLOW]->(c:CallSite) RETURN c.graphId AS graph, c.callee_class AS callee, c.callee_name AS method, count(s) AS literalArguments ORDER BY literalArguments DESC, graph, callee, method LIMIT 100

cases.name: field-type-inventory
cases.query: MATCH (f:Field) RETURN f.graphId AS graph, f.type AS fieldType, count(f) AS fields ORDER BY fields DESC, graph, fieldType LIMIT 100

cases.name: shared-wire-literals-prefiltered
cases.query: MATCH (a:StringConstant) WHERE a.value IN ['application/json', 'Content-Type', 'GET', 'POST'] WITH a MATCH (b:StringConstant) WHERE a.graphId <> b.graphId AND a.value = b.value RETURN a.graphId AS leftGraph, b.graphId AS rightGraph, a.value AS wireLiteral, count(*) AS pairs ORDER BY leftGraph, rightGraph, wireLiteral
